data.name: Sudhakar
data.long_meaning: Sudha means purity and Kar means doer. Thus, Sudhakar is a name given to one who has good knowledge or is a learned man.

Thus, the name Sudhakar signifies the quest for knowledge and the pursuit of inner purity in the spiritual journey.
